g.text: The former store becomes the wellness room, 3.9 x 3.3 m, reached from

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: the hall: changing bench, two showers, and a sauna of about 4 m² for

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: 4-5 people, with L-shaped benches and a 2.3 m ceiling. A glass door

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: opens straight into the east half of the winter garden: two loungers,

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: a cold plunge tub, low planting along the glass, and a planted screen

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: that separates it from the entrance path.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Wood-fired stone stove, stoked from the utility room so wood, ash and

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: smoke stay out of the hot room. Its own flue rises in a masonry chase

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: through the co-working floor, giving off heat on the way. A tank on

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: the stove can heat the shower water.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Steam suits the plants but not the glass: top vents in the glazing, an

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: extract fan in the shower room, and a vapour barrier behind the sauna

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: lining. Shower and plunge water go to the greywater system.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: General storage moves to the utility room and under the stair.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Indicative only. Sauna stove clearances, flue and fire safety must

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: follow local rules; permits may be required.
